cross-reference.answer: Read §2002:8.8.2 whole: formation rules 1-5 with Table 5, evaluation rule 6 (parentheses, then B-NOT, B-AND, B-XOR, B-OR, left to right), rule 7 (shorter operand extended on the right with boolean zeros) and rule 8 (result length). §2023:8.8.2 is the same text plus the boolean shift operators (a formation item, parts of its rules 2, 5 and 8, Table 4's shift row, the shift precedence paragraph) and NOTE 2 on zero-length operands, which an expression of boolean literals cannot have; so the 2002 requirement is the 2023 one without shifts, and shifts are refused at 2002 (w/pb1370-directive-shift-below-2023.cob, COBOL0900, in the reader's evidence). Formation rules 1-5 and Table 5 of 2002 are 2023's rules 1-6 and Table 4 without the shift entries.

pending-clause.answer: §2002:8.8.1.1, 8.8.1.3.1 and 8.8.1.3.6 are arithmetic (native versus standard arithmetic, the standard intermediate data item, exponentiation) and a boolean expression's evaluation does not use them; §2002:8.8.2 is read under the cross-reference flag; §2002:8.8.4.1.1 governs comparing a boolean expression as a relation operand, not forming or evaluating it; §2002:8.8.4.2.4 abbreviated combined relation conditions are barred in a constant conditional expression (§2002:7.2.7.1 SR1). The rule rests on none of the differing text.

behaviour-switch.answer: The switch is DialectBehavior.CompileTimeArithmeticImplementorDefined (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Control/DialectBehavior.cs:301), read only by CompileTimeArithmetic.For (src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Frontend/Expressions/CompileTimeArithmetic.cs:44), which picks the mode for operand entry and + - * / inside a compile-time arithmetic expression (§2002:7.2.5.2 GR1; its 34-digit 2002 mode against §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1's 32 digits is the known PB5575-family defect, reaching only results of arithmetic operations). A compile-time boolean expression is evaluated by boolean operations on boolean positions (§2002:8.8.2, its rule 7), never through the arithmetic mode the switch selects. Re-run now at --std 2002: b_prec.cob and b_eval.cob run as expected; b_numop.cob, b_alnumop.cob (non-boolean operand) and b_order.cob (malformed sequence) refused with COBOL1619 (E:\COBOL-coord\scratch\op-20261114\read-2002\out-answer\probes-a-03\run-q01-2002.log).
